facts.text: GO2Real is the clone's user-facing robot interface class
GO2Real creates a CycloneDDS participant, a state DataReader and low- and high-command DataWriters
getJointStates returns the joint angles q, velocities dq, estimated torques tau_est and motor temperatures
getIMU returns acceleration, angular velocity, quaternion and IMU temperature
getFootContacts returns the raw foot contact forces
setCommandsHigh writes v_x, v_y and omega_z to the high-level command writer
setCommandsLow requires q_des, dq_des, kp, kd and tau_ff arrays of 12 elements and writes them to the low-level command writer
The bridge names the 12 motor_state entries FR, FL, RR, RL and copies them in that order into go2py_state q, dq, tau and motor_temp
The bridge sets Estop = 1 when the wireless remote's R2 and L2 buttons are pressed and Estop = 0 with L2 and A
While Estop is set the bridge sends a damp request and a zero low-level command with kd 3 to all 12 motors
The upstream FSM's tracking move uses kp 150 and kv 3 and its damping mode uses kd 2
The URDF states the position range, effort and velocity of every leg joint
The MuJoCo model states the motor torque control range as +-23.7 for the hip and thigh motors and +-45.43 for the calf motors
The README describes the C++ bridge as implementing a remote-controlled emergency stop
